06b93e60: If there is data in DE(DQ), go to the PR label. Otherwise, execute W and TR.
ef30163f: If X is empty, and DV doesn't contain 'R', go to A. If X is empty and DV is not empty, go to X. If X is empty and D'>0, go to X. Otherwise, go to A.
4dcc47f6: If X starts with a '?', go to QS. If X contains '^', execute D and then go to ^DIE17.
4de56f51: If X is '@', execute D and then go to Z^DIE2.
6059a981: If X is a space, DV contains 'd', and DV doesn't contain 'P', and there is data in ^DISV(DUZ,"DIE",DLB), set X to the value in ^(DLB). If DV doesn't contain 'D' or 'S', write '  '_X.

26fc1ec8: If DV is not empty, go to M^DIE17. If DV contains 'V', go to ^DIE3. If DV doesn't contain 'S', go to P. If there is data in ^DD(DP,DIFLD,12.1), execute ^(12.1). Set % to the value after the last ';'_X_':' in ';'_DU, and set Y to X. If % is not empty and there is data in DIC("S"), execute DIC("S"). If there is no data in DB(DQ), write '  '_%. Go to V.

4a8b7652: If the input string contains a colon and the text before the colon matches the specified 'X' parameter, execute any code in the DIC("S") array and quit if the input string contains the colon.

22c2d05e: If the DB array does not have an element at the index DQ, write the portion of the input string following the colon to the current device. Set the variable X to the portion of the input string before the colon.

89e8c63d: If the DV string contains 'P', set the DIC array to the input string, and set the DIC(0) variable to either 'ENM' or 'ELM' based on whether DB has an element at index DQ and whether DV contains the single quote character. If DV contains 'P' followed by a number, set the DLAYGO variable to that number. If DV does not contain '*', call the DIC routine, set X to the returned value, and set DIC to DIE. Quit if X is negative.

3f6847fc: If DV does not contain 'N', jump to the 'V' label. Otherwise, execute the 'D' routine. If the portion of X after the decimal point is longer than 24 characters, kill (undefine) X and jump to the 'Z' label.
eaf8f9e1: This line handles formatting of numbers with decimal points. It removes leading and trailing zeroes, and if the number is a whole number (has no decimal part), it converts it to an integer.
a23b425b: Delete the Y(0) node and any undefined nodes in the temporary storage array.
fa9fa75d: If X is defined and not null, store it in the current data array DG and save it for future auditing if this is a date/time field. Go to label A.
14eee525: If the data is invalid (represented by ?), write a ? character to the terminal and jump to the Z^DIE17 label to handle the invalid data.
4d43d09f: Set the value of X to ?BAD to indicate an invalid data value.
d9c91de2: Set the variable DZ to the current value of X, call the D and QQ^DIEQ routines, and go to the B label.
9c54829b: Set up the DQ(DQ) array node with the current field, value, and other field attributes from the DIFLD and DV variables.

ef6cb3b3: If the DE(DQ) node is not defined, call the O routine. If X is not @, go to the RD label. If DV does not contain an R (for REQUIRED) and X is @, go to label A. If X is @, set X to Y and go to the N label.
318447a7: Check if cross-reference is defined and execute it if it exists.
59ecf076: If input variable contains 'P', check the file referenced by DU and retrieve the corresponding global reference and piece data. Then loop back to check the next data level.

0d00035f: If input variable contains 'V' and the Y-reference is valid, retrieve the corresponding global reference and piece data. Update DG and X variables with the data dictionary information. Then loop back to check the next data level.
54ed1ebb: If the user response starts with 'D', look up and return the corresponding data dictionary definition.

d8c5ea55: If the user enters nothing, set the response to the default edit value. If there is no default edit value, go to the reader help. If the data is computed no further input is allowed (DC<2). If the data is computed multiple times, branch to get the next iteration of data.
0a0f303f: If the data validation does not allow INVISIBLE or COMPUTED-FIELD, go to the reader.
cac2b9b3: Call the INPUT transform, and if the input is valid, go to the reader. Otherwise, prompt again.
47185e76: Exit the INPUT reader.
b8643432: Initialize variables for the INPUT reader.

4d64599e: Set DU to the prefix for the VA(200 file global.
ba24a54c: Assign the value of DGJT1PH to X.
8323f27d: Copy the value of X into Y.
